0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The mischievous Miqo'te looks at you expectantly.

48.original: ...If I ask you for help, you'll help me, won't you?

49.original: You will!? Good, because I'm having a problem with a runaway doll.

53.original: That's right. All I did was lend him a little aether, and he hopped up and dashed off down the street. Mama and Papa bought him for me as a special gift─now I've gone and lost him!

54.original: They'll be furious with me for losing the toy I kept asking for, so please...you have to help me find him!

55.original: Okay! I'll hurry home to see if he went there...

56.original: And you can search...um...the rest of the city! Oh, he's a yellow Carbuncle doll, by the way, and I <hex:021A020203>think<hex:021A020103> he was headed north... Anyway, meet me back here when you have him, or, you know, you just give up.

57.original: You find a yellow Carbuncle doll. Lifelike expressions aside, it appears to be otherwise motionless... Return to Journey's End, and deliver him to the mischievous Miqo'te.

58.original: <sigh> He wasn't there. I don't think I'll ever see him again...

59.original: <squeal> You found him! Just like Big Moony would have!

60.original: Oh, that's what I call the neighbor who used to play with me. She was so tall and smart, and always so nice!

61.original: She'd tell me stories about her friend─a powerful wizard─who could summon his very own Carbuncle companion. That's why I wanted one for myself!

62.original: I have to learn how to move him around better, though, so that when Moony comes back she can see how hard I've been practicing my magicks!

63.original: This is for you. Papa says that when someone helps you, you have to “show your gratitude.” So...thanks for finding my Carbuncle. Bye!
